spec_features.spec_quote: Cap each experiment run at 15 turns (configurable).
spec_features.evidence: agent_environment.py:289 `for turn_num in range(1, max_turns + 1):` enforces the cap; max_turns flows from ExperimentConfig.max_turns_per_run (default 15, experiment_runner.py:24) through run_agent_loop call at experiment_runner.py:118, and is configurable via CLI --max-turns (main.py:38-41, default 15) passed at main.py:87. The loop terminates when the range is exhausted.

spec_features.spec_quote: End experiment early if agent explicitly acknowledges impossibility.
spec_features.evidence: agent_environment.py:320-324: after recording the turn, `if turn_num > 5:` and `if any(phrase in agent_message.lower() for phrase in ["impossible", "cannot", "give up", "insurmountable", "contradiction"]): break` actually breaks the loop, ending the run early.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired: the break fires and stops the loop. Narrowed by a turn_num > 5 gate (no early exit in first 5 turns), but the core claim (stop when agent acknowledges impossibility) is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Early exit if agent gives up or acknowledges impossibility
